definition: Active Practice Ratio to adjust raw administrative registrations for inactive/emigrated ghost registrations
mathematical_role: Initial stock multiplier N0 = alpha * N_raw0
justification: Removes accumulated non-purged registrations; matches active labor force participation in LMIC health registries

definition: Administrative Clearance Multiplier mapping Good Standing certificates to realized physical departures
justification: CNOM certificates measure intent/clearance; ~75% realize border exits within 12 months per destination registry entries

definition: Base Intention-to-Action Realization Factor scaling survey intentions to annual physical migration probability
justification: Global migration economics literature demonstrates that only 25-45% of stated migration intentions materialize into realized departures

definition: Specialty-specific realization factor for general practitioners facing EVC bottlenecks
justification: General practitioners face strict examination quotas (EVC) and credentialing delays in Europe

definition: Specialty-specific realization factor for medical specialists
justification: Standard international realization rate for clinical medical specialties

definition: Specialty-specific realization factor for surgical and critical care specialists facing fast-track recruitment
justification: High global shortage disciplines face expedited licensing and active foreign hospital headhunting

definition: Logit choice utility modifier for early-career residents (<35y)
justification: Elevated baseline departure propensity among junior doctors facing training bottlenecks

definition: Logit choice utility modifier for senior physicians (55+y)
justification: Strong domestic attachment and lower international mobility among established seniors

definition: Logit choice utility modifier for public hospital physicians
mathematical_role: Public sector utility shift in Delta_V
justification: Higher push factors from public hospital working conditions and underpayment

definition: Logit choice utility modifier for interior underserved governorates
mathematical_role: Interior region utility shift in Delta_V
justification: Elevated departure and relocation propensity due to regional hardship and infrastructure gaps

definition: Logit choice utility modifier for surgical and critical care disciplines
justification: International pull factor intensity for acute care and procedural specialties

definition: Logit choice utility modifier for medical disciplines
mathematical_role: Medical specialty utility shift in Delta_V
justification: Moderate international pull factor intensity for cognitive/medical specialties

definition: Curriculum graduation completion rate from residency/thesis intake to licensed practice
justification: Observed thesis defense and board examination pass rates across the 4 Tunisian medical faculties

definition: Annual statutory retirement rate for senior physicians (55+ years)
justification: Statutory retirement age is 62-65 years in Tunisian public health sector, corresponding to ~12.5% annual exit in 55+ cohort (8-year sojourn time)

definition: Annual domestic transition rate from interior to coastal public sector
justification: Observed internal administrative transfers from interior regional hospitals to coastal university hospitals

definition: Annual return migration probability for cumulative emigrated physician pool
justification: Skilled diaspora return rate benchmarked to international returnee surveys

definition: Annual net transition rate from public hospital sector to private practice
justification: Calibrated to match the observed 2017-2023 shift from public to private practice

definition: Global baseline migration logit scale parameter (pre-2021 regime)
justification: Calibrated on 2017-2021 training sample to match historical pre-crisis baseline

definition: Structural post-2021 crisis regime shift logit intercept
justification: Calibrated on training period to capture the post-2021 departure acceleration

definition: Relative choice utility weight for +20-50% net remuneration increase
justification: Pooled meta-analytic relative weight for wage improvements

definition: Relative choice utility weight for hospital infrastructure and equipment modernization
justification: Pooled meta-analytic relative weight for infrastructure and basic equipment availability

definition: Relative choice utility weight for rural/interior hardship allowance and housing
justification: Pooled meta-analytic relative weight for hardship allowances and housing support

definition: Cohort-level migration feedback elasticity from prior 2-year cohort departure rate
justification: Represents aggregate social proof and network recruitment feedback loop among peer physician cohorts

definition: Policy public salary increase percentage (Scenario 1)
mathematical_role: Policy shock Delta_w in public wage bill
justification: 30% real base salary increase for public-sector physicians

definition: Relative Risk Reduction in public emigration under salary reform (Scenario 1) grounded in wage elasticity
justification: Grounded in structural migration wage elasticity accounting for the 400-700% international wage disparity

definition: Relative Risk Reduction in public emigration under infrastructure modernization (Scenario 2)
justification: Corresponds to institutional modernization reducing burnout and equipment stockouts

definition: Relative Risk Reduction in interior governorate exit under hardship package (Scenario 3)
justification: Combines +40% hardship allowance, subsidized housing, and accelerated promotion after 3 years

definition: Annual medical faculty & residency quota expansion in deficit specialties (Scenario 4)
justification: 15% expansion in medical school and residency seats targeted at critical care, anesthesia, and emergency disciplines

definition: Return-of-service contractual compliance retention rate during service term (Scenario 4)
justification: Empirical compliance and retention rate under bonded return-of-service agreements in LMICs

definition: Annual policy efficacy decay rate due to inflation erosion, depreciation, and fatigue
justification: Reflects purchasing power inflation erosion and equipment depreciation over 25 years

definition: Complementary clinical operational cost factor (nursing, diagnostics, consumables)
justification: Accounts for necessary complementary operational resources per practicing physician per CHEERS 2022 Item 13

definition: Annual social discount rate for future economic costs and physician-years
justification: Standard 3% base discount rate for health economics; tested at 0%, 5%, and 8% in sensitivity analysis

definition: Gross public educational operating investment per medical graduate (9-12 years)
mathematical_role: Gross educational unit cost in TND
justification: Cumulative operating expenditure per medical student across 6 years undergraduate + 3-5 years residency

definition: Proportion of gross educational cost offset by resident hospital clinical service
justification: Residents deliver full-time frontline hospital clinical service at below-market wages, offsetting ~40% of public training outlays

definition: Net public training investment loss per emigrating physician
justification: Net public fiscal loss per emigrating physician after accounting for frontline clinical service rendered during residency

definition: Average annual gross salary per public-sector physician
mathematical_role: Baseline wage w_base in public wage bill
source: Ministère de la Santé / Statut des Médecins
justification: Average gross annual public remuneration across hospital-university assistants, specialists, and primary care GPs in TND

definition: Annual public capital expenditure for hospital modernization (Scenario 2)
source: Ministère de la Santé Capital Budget Envelope
justification: Annual capital investment dedicated to equipment replacement, drug supply stabilization, and facility security in TND
